name: What needs to be done before hiring a contractor to paint a foreclosed house?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before hiring a contractor to paint a foreclosed house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before painters arrive, the property must have active electric and water service, and all trash or abandoned belongings should be cleared out. Painting requires sufficient lighting to spot wall defects and water for cleaning and equipment wash-up. If the property has severe plumbing leaks or active roof issues, those should be addressed first to protect newly painted surfaces. You should also confirm whether trim, interior doors, and ceilings are included in the scope or just walls. Owner Abraham Becerra walks the site directly with clients to confirm these job-readiness requirements ahead of time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure water and electricity are turned on, remove debris and abandoned items, resolve active leaks, and clarify whether ceilings and trim are included in the scope.
